rubrics.name: Grade 5 English Admission Writing Rubric — 15 marks
rubrics.subject: english

criteria.name: Ideas and task response
descriptors: Responds clearly to the prompt with relevant ideas.
Adds enough detail to develop the response for a Grade 5 reader.

criteria.name: Organisation and cohesion
descriptors: Uses a clear beginning, middle, and ending or a clear paragraph sequence.
Links ideas with suitable connectives and paragraphing.

criteria.name: Language accuracy and vocabulary
descriptors: Uses varied vocabulary suitable for the task.
Controls sentence structure, punctuation, and spelling well enough for meaning to be clear.
